sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: New Paths is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello, mercenary. My partners urgently need to move something important through the city center. You know how isolated the districts have become and how dangerous the main roads are. We need you to scout a route from TerraGroup Headquarters to the Rodina Cinema. My men noticed that some bandits have found a shortcut between the districts. It would allow us to reach several different locations in a single raid. Make sure the route is safe."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Scout the intersection of Mira Ave and the overpass on Ground Zero (In one raid)
- Locate the passage leading to Streets of Tarkov on Ground Zero (In one raid)
- Use the transit from Ground Zero to Streets of Tarkov (In one raid)
- Survive and extract from Streets of Tarkov (or transit to the next location)
  - (Optional) Scout the area around the Rodina cinema on Streets of Tarkov (In one raid)

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,000 EXP
- Peacekeeper Rep +0.1
- 550 Dollars
  - 578 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 632 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Wonderful, you found it! This will make operating in central Tarkov much easier for both you and us."

sections.heading: Ground Zero to Streets of Tarkov
sections.text: Next to the Mira Ave extraction. Transits are only available 1 min after raid start.
